alleys.note: 10' alley (with 4" water pipe) from Chickasaw east to Rohs, ending at Rohs (T); it is the continuation of the 10' alley that crosses Chickasaw on sheet 251
10' alley through block 3 (between the Wheeler and West Clifton frontages) from McMillan to Warner, T at both ends; the block number 3 is printed in it

bends.note: start of curve: the straight SSW run from McMillan (about 7 deg off vertical) turns due south
end of curve: due south from here to Warner

notes: Names printed without a suffix (CHICKASAW, ROHS, WHEELER, WARNER, and the 241 overlap labels LYON, ATKINSON, BOSLEY) are written with 'Street'; W. CLIFTON AV. is 'West Clifton Avenue'; the street entering McMillan from the north at x~2577/3064 (printed on 259 as CLIFTON AV.) is 'Clifton Avenue'. W. McMillan (60', north line y~243 at the left to ~295 at the right, south line ~597 to ~660) runs across the top; Chickasaw, Rohs and Wheeler end at it (the 259 blocks north of it are continuous). Clifton Avenue (about 80' as drawn here) comes down from 259 and ends at McMillan: block 2 south of McMillan (x~2349-3504) is continuous across its line, so it is a T, not a cross (sheet 259 recorded Clifton/McMillan as a cross from the key map and flagged it unverified). West Clifton Avenue crosses McMillan: north of McMillan it runs due N-S (lines x~5440/5876, ~72'), south of it it slants SSW (60', lines from (5452,669)/(5825,669)), then curves due south between y~3850 and ~4300 (lines x~5000/5363) and crosses Warner onto 240/242. Lyon, Atkinson and Bosley come in from the east (sheet 241 overlap) and end at West Clifton (its west frontage is continuous). Warner is 60' west of Wheeler (lines y~7182/7541) and 40' east of it (south line steps up to y~7432); the Wheeler/Warner point is the middle of the open crossing, as on 240. Chickasaw, Rohs, Wheeler and West Clifton all cross Warner (continue onto 240). The 10' alley from 251 continues east of Chickasaw to Rohs (T). Rohs is also 50' (printed).
